# Codevider

> Codevider is a software development company based in Tirana, Albania. We build AI-powered web, mobile, cloud, and enterprise software for startups, SMEs, and enterprises.

## Primary Resources

- [Homepage](https://www.codevider.com/): Main landing page and company overview
- [About](https://www.codevider.com/about): Company story, culture, and team
- [Services](https://www.codevider.com/services): AI, product engineering, cloud, and delivery offerings
- [Vibe-Code Rescue](https://www.codevider.com/vibe-code-rescue): Fixing and productionising AI-generated apps built with Lovable, Bolt, Cursor, Replit, v0, or Claude Code
- [The Business Show London](https://www.codevider.com/uk): Meet Codevider at ExCeL London, 11–12 Nov 2026, Stand B1350
- [Careers](https://www.codevider.com/career): Open roles and hiring process
- [Blog](https://www.codevider.com/blogs): Engineering and AI articles
- [Contact](https://www.codevider.com/#contact): Get in touch with Codevider

## Documentation

- [Complete Company Knowledge](https://www.codevider.com/llms-full.txt): Full technical capabilities, delivery process, industries, and FAQ

## What Codevider Does

Codevider provides:

- AI Application Development
- Vibe-Code Rescue (stabilising AI-generated apps for production)
- Custom Software Development
- Web Development
- Mobile App Development
- Cloud & DevOps Engineering
- Product Engineering
- Dedicated Engineering Teams
- System Integration
- UI/UX Design

## Technologies

React • Next.js • Angular • Vue • Node.js • NestJS • Python • FastAPI • Laravel • PostgreSQL • MongoDB • Docker • Kubernetes • AWS • Azure • Google Cloud • OpenAI • Anthropic • Gemini • MCP • AI Agents
